(formerly Cessna Aircraft Company) airplanes equipped with specific Aerospace Welding Minneapolis, Inc. muffler part numbers. The applicability is defined by muffler part number and aircraft model/serial number:

**For Muffler Part No. A1754001-23:**
- Model 172, Serial Numbers 17259224 and up
- Model 172R, Serial Numbers 80001 and up
- Model 172S, Serial Numbers 8001 and up

**For Muffler Part No. A1754001-25:**
- Model 172, Serial Numbers 17256513 and up
- Model 172R, Serial Numbers 80001 and up
- Model 172S, Serial Numbers 8001 and up
- Model 177, Serial Numbers 1770001 and up

**Source:** AD-2018-02-04, section "FIGURE 2 OF PARAGRAPH (c) OF THIS AD-AFFECTED AIRPLANES"
